subject.title: fix(mattermost): proactive message tool sends ignore thread context

question: Which path should own the remaining Mattermost cron/heartbeat thread-delivery fix for #45082 now that #93424 already fixed the message-tool half?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the open candidates overlap, are stale or draft, and touch compatibility-sensitive persisted delivery routing, so automation should not choose the permanent route-persistence shape alone.

options.title: Adopt or replace the route-persistence fix
options.body: Use #52236 or #77442 as source material for a narrow current-main-compatible fix with live Mattermost cron/heartbeat thread proof, and close/supersede #52120 as covered by #93424.

options.title: Wait on contributor branches
options.body: Leave #45082 open behind the existing PRs, accepting continued stale/conflicting PR state before the remaining bug is fixed.

options.title: Close remaining scope as not planned
options.body: Close #45082 despite the reporter-tested cron/heartbeat case and current source gap, which would require a maintainer decision that this behavior is no longer intended.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace the route-persistence fix
recommendation.body: Use #52236 or #77442 as source material for a narrow current-main-compatible fix with live Mattermost cron/heartbeat thread proof, and close/supersede #52120 as covered by #93424.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc merged #93424 and authored adjacent shared outbound-threading commits, making them the best available owner for choosing the follow-up route-persistence shape.
